source_text: eis qui in Ecclesia sunt presbyteris obaudire oportet, his qui successionem habent ab Apostolis, sicut ostendimus; qui cum episcopatus successione charisma veritatis certum secundum placitum Patris acceperunt: reliquos vero qui absistunt principali successione, et quocunque loco colliguntur, suspectos habere, vel quasi hereticos et mal sententize, vel quasi scindentes et elatos et sibi placentes, aut rursus ut hypocritas, queestus gratia et vanz gloriz hoc operantes. Omnes autem hi a veritate. Et heretici quidem alienum ignem afferentes ad altare Dei, id est alienas doctrinas, a ccelesti igne comburentur, quemadmodum Nadab et Abiud. Qui vero exsurgunt contra veritatem, et alteros adhortantur adversus Eecclesiam Dei, remanent apud inferos, voragine terre absorpti, quemadmodum circa Chore Dathan et Abiron. Qui autem scindunt et separant unitatem Ecclesie, eandem quam Hieroboam pcenam percipiunt a Deo.
pass_a_gloss: to those who are in the Church, it is necessary to obey the presbyters, to these who have succession from the Apostles, as we show; who with the succession of the episcopate received a certain charisma of truth according to the will of the Father; but the rest, indeed, who stand away from the principal succession, and are gathered in whatever place, it is necessary to consider suspicious, or as heretics and of bad opinion, or as those who split and are puffed up and please themselves, or again as hypocrites, who do this for the sake of gain and vain glory. All these, however, are far from the truth. And the heretics, indeed, bringing foreign fire to the altar of God, that is foreign doctrines, will be burned by the heavenly fire, just as Nadab and Abiu. Those who rise up against the truth, and encourage others against the Church of God, remain in the underworld, swallowed by the abyss of the earth, just as Dathan and Abiron around the cleft. Those, however, who split and separate the unity of the Church, receive the same penalty from God as Hieroboam.

choices.why: meaning a deep or seemingly bottomless pit
meaning to be self-satisfied or complacent

pass_b_english: It is necessary to obey the presbyters who are in the Church, those who possess succession from the Apostles, just as we have shown; for they, together with the succession of the episcopate, have received a certain charisma of truth according to the will of the Father (Leviticus 10:1-2). But those others who stand apart from the principal succession, and who gather in whatever place, must be regarded with suspicion, whether as heretics and men of bad judgment, or as those who divide, are puffed up, and please themselves, or again as hypocrites who act for the sake of gain and vain glory (Numbers 16:31-33). All these, however, are far from the truth (1 Kings 12:26-33). The heretics, bringing foreign fire to the altar of God — that is, foreign doctrines — will be consumed by heavenly fire, just as Nadab and Abihu were. Those who rise up against the truth and urge others against the Church of God remain in the underworld, swallowed by the abyss of the earth, just as Dathan and Abiram were at the cleft. But those who tear apart and separate the unity of the Church receive from God the same penalty as Jeroboam.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Latin text. Pass B correctly identifies and adds the required inline scripture citations for the biblical allusions (Leviticus 10:1-2 for Nadab and Abihu; Numbers 16:31-33 for Dathan and Abiram; 1 Kings 12:26-33 for Jeroboam) which were present in the sense of the Latin but not explicitly cited in the source text, fulfilling the requirement for added identifications. Pass B maintains the agency and modality of the Latin (e.g., 'must be regarded' for 'suspectos habere').
